water: Use case: stylized-concept. Small game DASH TRAIL FRAGMENTS for Spirit Gate 2D RPG, style/colors inspired by reference but compact instead of its long/ring shape. cyan/azure WATER with thin white foam edges, two short pointed wave chevrons flowing RIGHT, a little spray. Exactly6 separate frames in strict3columns2rows grid. Every frame has the same small horizontal directional glyph at exactcellcenter50%50%; fixedscale. These are repeating fragments stamped BEHIND a moving player, each fragment displayed48x24px, so make strong clean readable center strokes. Full clear chevron shapes already present inframe1, frames2-6 subtlyshift wave/wisp details but SAME readable brightness and size, NOT a grow/shrink cycle. It is a short two-chevron motionmark like >>, no enclosing ring/hollowcircle, no character, no hand, no explosion. Crisp pixelclusters with generous20% transparent margins in each cell, no crossingcells. Genuine transparent alpha background, NO colored/black/gray glowbackdrop, no checkerboard, no text/gridlines. Reference is palette/finish only.
